omg.datamodule.structure module#

class omg.datamodule.structure.Structure(cell: Tensor, atomic_numbers: Tensor, pos: Tensor, property_dict: dict[str, Any] | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, pos_is_fractional: bool = False)[source]#

Bases: object

Storage for a single crystalline structure of atoms.

The structure is represented by its cell, atom numbers, and Cartesian or fractional atom coordinates. Additionally, one can store arbitrary properties and metadata associated with the structure in this class.

This class also provides methods to change the representation of the structure. It is possible to convert the Cartesian atom coordinates to fractional coordinates and vice versa, and to Niggli reduce the structure.

Parameters:

  • cell (torch.Tensor) – A 3x3 matrix of the lattice vectors. The [i, j]-th element is the jth Cartesian coordinate of the ith unit vector.

  • atomic_numbers (torch.Tensor) – A vector of N integers giving the atomic numbers of the atoms, where N is the number of atoms.

  • pos (torch.Tensor) – A Nx3 matrix of the fractional or Cartesian coordinates of the atoms in the structure, where N is the number of atoms.

  • property_dict (Optional[dict[str, Any]]) – An optional dictionary of properties associated with the structure. Defaults to None.

  • metadata (Optional[dict[str, Any]]) – An optional dictionary of metadata associated with the structure. Defaults to None.

  • pos_is_fractional (bool) – Whether the given atomic positions are in fractional coordinates. Defaults to False.

Raises:

AssertionError – If the cell is not a 3x3 matrix or if the pos is not a Nx3 matrix, where N is the length of species.

classmethod from_dictionary(data: dict[str, Tensor], property_keys: Sequence[str], metadata: dict[str, Any], pos_is_fractional: bool = False) → Structure[source]#

Create a Structure object from the given data dictionary and metadata.

The data dictionary is expected to contain at least the following keys:

  • “cell”: A 3x3 torch.Tensor of the lattice vectors.

    The [i, j]-th element is the jth Cartesian coordinate of the ith unit vector.

  • “pos”: A Nx3 torch.Tensor of fractional or Cartesian atomic positions.

  • “atomic_numbers”: A torch tensor of N integers giving the atomic numbers of the atoms.

Additionally, the data dictionary should contain additional property keys specified in the property_keys sequence.

Parameters:

  • data (dict[str, torch.Tensor]) – A dictionary representing the structure.

  • property_keys (Sequence[str]) – A sequence of property keys to be included in the Structure’s property_dict.

  • metadata (dict[str, Any]) – A dictionary of metadata to be included in the Structure’s metadata.

  • pos_is_fractional (bool) – Whether the atomic positions in the data dictionary are in fractional coordinates. Defaults to False.

Returns:

A Structure object created from the data dictionary and metadata.

Return type:

Structure

to(floating_point_precision: dtype) → None[source]#

Convert the floating point precision of the structure to the given torch precision.

Parameters:

floating_point_precision (torch.dtype) – The torch floating point dtype to convert to. Should be one of torch.float32, torch.float64, torch.float16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e5m2, torch.float8_e4m3fnuz, torch.float8_e5m2fnuz, torch.float8_e8m0fnu, or torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2.

Raises:

ValueError – If the given floating point precision is not supported.

to_dictionary() → dict[str, Any][source]#

Return the structure as a data dictionary.

The returned dictionary contains the following keys: - “cell”: A 3x3 torch.Tensor of the lattice vectors. - “pos”: A Nx3 torch.Tensor of Cartesian atomic positions. - “atomic_numbers”: A torch tensor of N integers giving the atomic numbers of the atoms.

Additionally, the dictionary includes all properties from the property_dict and metadata.

Returns:

A data dictionary representing the structure.

Return type:

dict[str, Any]
